{{Top|leg}}
The '''Vixani March''' was a militant [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Droid rights/Legends|rights]] organization, formed by droids who believed the only way to freedom was through armed resistance. Members of the group would pass their ideas and methods on to other droids, even those not built for military purposes, and try to sway them to their cause. They held that all [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] were culpable in the continued [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] of droids, and as such, any organic being was a target.
